limits: Whole-device VRAM and whole-host RAM include desktop and other applications; sampled peaks can miss transients. RSS sums may double-count shared pages.
Short 4-step, rank8Wan/rank4H3 trials prove mechanics/capacity for these settings, not learning quality, longer-run stability or a general speedup.
OS file caches, device/kernel warm-up and power/temperature were not controlled. Model loading explains part of the wall-time differences; do not attribute the full difference to swapping.
Received tqdm log windows can lag actual inference because carriage-return output is buffered. Synchronized phase probes use nested-call exclusive timings instead.

Native preview timing includes existing before/sample/after hooks and residency restoration. A separate return-to-training duration is not observable; the next optimizer step and changed checkpoint payload establish continuation.
No real-GPU OOM was induced. One-attempt capacity recovery, non-capacity failure, output preservation and persistence are covered by public subprocess/Run/browser regressions.
CPU fixtures do not establish GPU memory safety or performance. Unqualified settings fall back, and new GPU consumers after freezing are not predictable.
